propositions: Recursive conftest glob tests/**/conftest.py in global_support incorrectly selects all seven mutation shards for unrelated nested conftest changes.

Runtime tracing of configured shard tests reveals pytest loads only six ancestor conftests, not sibling fixture trees; unrelated conftests like tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py are never loaded by any shard.
Seven proven over-trigger candidates across 97 recent Verify runs consumed 5.38 runner-hours without increasing coverage, indicating unnecessary shard selection.
Exact conftest ancestry mapping pins each non-root conftest to only the shards whose configured tests load it, while keeping tests/conftest.py as true global support.
A derived ancestry contract must independently expand configured test files and directories, derive ancestor conftests, and assert the per-shard manifest support closure matches the derived set.
